tagline: We automate and transform. We create ways to win.
hero_kpi_rationale: Double-digit growth in annual recurring revenue is a pillar of Rockwell Automation's profitable growth strategy, indicating stable and predictable demand for its solutions and services.
company_description: Rockwell Automation, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides industrial automation and digital transformation solutions in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. It operates in three segments: Intelligent Devices, Software & Control, and Lifecycle Services. The company offers drives, motion, advanced material handling, safety, sensing, industrial components, hardware, software, and configured-to-order products; and control and visualization software and hardware, digital twin, simulation and information software, network and security infrastructure, and custom-engineered systems. It also provides digital consulting, professional services, engineered-to-order solutions, recurring services, cybersecurity, safety, remote monitoring, customer technical support and repair, asset management and optimization consulting, and training, as well as spare parts. The company sells its products through independent distributors in relation to its direct sales force. kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from recurring contracts such as services, software subscriptions, and maintenance.
kpis.description: Rockwell Automation targets double-digit annual recurring revenue growth, emphasizing revenue stability and predictability through services and subscriptions as part of its long-term profitable growth framework.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in annual recurring revenue.

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, representing profit after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects production efficiency and the company's pricing strategy in the industrial automation sector.
kpis.signal: Solid gross margin in industrial automation sector.

kpis.name: R&D Investment as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D spending is crucial for maintaining competitive advantage in the technology and industrial automation solutions sector. MD&A mentions 'investments in technology and globalization' and 'Differentiation through Technology Innovation and Domain Expertise' as strategic keys, but no specific R&D percentage is provided.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for acquiring or upgrading physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex is an indicator of capacity expansion and investments in future infrastructure to support profitable growth and operations.
kpis.signal: Targeted investment to support future growth.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of company employees as of the closing date.
kpis.description: Headcount as of September 30, 2025 was 26,000 employees distributed across North America (9,000), Europe/Middle East/Africa (5,000), Asia-Pacific (7,000), and Latin America (5,000), with 33% female representation and a culture of integrity and innovation.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth supporting revenue expansion.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.38 last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.591B last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 68.0% last year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Annual consolidated revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 fiscal years of 10-K filings.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Annual consolidated net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years of 10-K filings.

kpis.name: AI-Enabled Deals Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customer transactions that incorporate artificial intelligence solutions.
kpis.description: MD&A confirms that industrial AI applications are a key area of inorganic investment and that AI is part of converging megatrends (digitization and AI). However, no specific percentage or metric of AI-enabled deals is provided in the 10-K.
kpis.signal: Growing adoption of AI-enabled solutions by customers.

kpis.name: Software & Control Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the segment dedicated to software and industrial control.
kpis.description: The Software & Control segment includes control and visualization software, digital twins, simulation and information software, as well as network and security infrastructure. The segment composition is confirmed in the 10-K Item 1 Business section, and Logix is described as a key differentiator due to its unique integrated architecture supporting discrete, process, batch, safety, security, motion, robotics, and power control automation.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in software segment driving digital transformation.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Allows visualization of the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Manufacturing Demand Slowdown
risks.summary: The U.S. manufacturing PMI has remained below 50 for several months, signaling economic contraction. This directly affects ROK since more than half of its sales come from the U.S. market.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-report with moderate language ('mixed', 'below 50'). U.S. manufacturing PMI has remained below 50 since Q4 2025, a stable but concerning trend. Macroeconomic category weighs heavily for industrial equipment manufacturers. U.S. sales > 50% of total.

risks.title: Asbestos-Related Liabilities and Environmental Risks
risks.summary: ROK recorded an exceptional charge of $136 million to change its accounting method for asbestos defense costs and increase provisions for future claims. This historical liability represents a significant and growing financial exposure.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mid-report with strong language ('elected to change accounting method'). $136 million charge in Q4 2025 for accounting method change and increased provisions. New elevated risk (accounting change). Litigation/environmental category = high weight. Material impact on EPS (-$0.91).

risks.title: Asset Impairments and Goodwill Write-Downs
risks.summary: ROK recorded an impairment charge of $224 million on its Sensia joint venture in 2025, compared to $144 million the previous year. This increase in asset impairments reduces earnings and signals difficulties with certain investments.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mid-report with direct language ('non-cash impairment charge'). $224 million impairment charge on Sensia joint venture in 2025 vs. $144 million in 2024. Elevated trend (doubling). Capital category = high weight. Direct impact on earnings and EPS.

risks.title: Global Tax Increases (BEPS Pillar Two)
risks.summary: The OECD's BEPS Pillar Two agreement imposes a minimum 15% tax rate in each jurisdiction. ROK anticipates an approximately 3% increase in its effective tax rate starting in 2026, notably through Singapore.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mid-report with moderate but explicit language ('expected to result in'). Estimated +3% impact on effective tax rate starting 2026. New trend (enactment in progress). Regulatory category = high weight. Affects overall cash flows.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Volatility
risks.summary: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations negatively affect ROK's results, particularly in Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. This impact compounds volume challenges in these regions.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mid-report with moderate language ('unfavorable net currency'). International sales < 50% but EMEA and APAC regions declining (-3% and -4% organic). Stable but persistent trend. Macro category = medium weight. Impact on segment margins.

risks.title: Difficulty Attracting and Retaining Talent
risks.summary: ROK faces challenges attracting and retaining its 26,000 skilled employees. Compensation costs increased in 2025, reducing operating margins.
risks.score_rationale: Risk early in report ('Item 1A. Risk Factors for a discussion of risks relating to our inability to attract, develop, and retain'). Moderate but explicit language. Higher compensation in 2025 (negative margin impact). Elevated trend (rising HR costs). Key personnel category = medium weight.

risks.title: Volume Decline and Margin Compression
risks.summary: Despite a 3% price increase, ROK experienced a 2% volume decline in 2025, particularly in the Intelligent Devices segment. This contraction suggests competitive pressure or weak customer demand.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mid-report with factual language ('Volume decreased total company sales by approximately 2 percentage points'). Volume decline despite price increase (+3%). Stable but concerning trend. Competition/industrial category = medium weight. Affects all segments.

risks.title: Tariff Dependence and Supply Chain Exposure
risks.summary: ROK actively manages the impact of tariffs through alternative sourcing and production localization strategies. The company anticipates a neutral impact on earnings in 2026 but remains exposed to geopolitical risks.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mid-report with moderate language ('continue to manage the impact of tariffs'). Mitigation in place (alternative sourcing, localization). Stable trend (tariffs expected neutral in 2026). Geopolitical category = medium weight. Requires ongoing actions.

ai_positioning.summary: Rockwell Automation positions itself as an integrator of industrial AI solutions, with AI applications as a key priority for inorganic investment, aligned with the converging megatrends of digitization and AI mentioned in the 10-K MD&A long-term strategy.
